H1 > H2 > H3 creates three levels of heading nesting

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Top Level</h1><p>Top intro.</p><h2>Mid Level</h2><p>Mid content.</p><h3>Deep Level</h3><p>Deep content.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(include_document_structure: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.document.nodes.inspect
```
